name: Crew Quarters
narrativeOnEnter: Four bunks, two occupied with personal effects. Lockers, a small desk, a mirror cracked at the corner. Personal items are scattered — whoever left did so quickly. One bunk has a data pad on the pillow.

action.text:
MERIDIAN STATION ALPHA — CREW IDENTIFICATION

Name: CHEN, YUKI
Role: Navigation Officer
Crew ID: #0447

Navigation terminal password: MERIDIAN (station default)

Handwritten note on the back:
'Pod bay code — last four of mission stamp: 5519
DO NOT WRITE DOWN — but I always forget it.'

A personal photograph. Four crew members in orange jumpsuits, posing in front of an airlock. They're smiling.

Written on the back in blue ink:
'Meridian Alpha, Launch Day — Year 3'

One of them has a name tag: CHEN.

PERSONAL LOG — CHEN, YUKI — ENTRY 44

'Station's been acting up for two days. Reactor deck is throwing warnings I've never seen before. Kovalev thinks it's a coolant calibration issue. He's gone down to check.

If this goes sideways:
— Engineering wiring schematic is taped inside the panel cover
— Reactor sequence is in the safety manual on Reactor Deck
— Cargo lock pattern is on the freight manifest in the Cargo Bay

Escape pod bay is stern lower deck. Code is on my ID tag. I keep forgetting.'

A regulation bunk, stripped down. Whoever slept here took their belongings. A sticky note is attached to the frame:

'Reactor sequence override code: ask Kovalev. He knows.'

A bunk with a rumpled sleep sack. A worn paperback book is wedged at the pillow end.

Inside the front cover: a name. 'KOVALEV, D.' And below it:

'Station callsign: MERIDIAN. All terminal passwords default to station callsign on first login.'
